integrity: The proof is exact and non-computational. It does not infer subspace d-weak convergence from ambient C(K) convergence; it checks internal metric functionals directly in the represented closed sublattice and then passes to their pointwise closure.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to real AM-spaces and uses Kakutani's supremum-norm representation. It does not extend the all-disjoint-sequences conclusion to arbitrary Banach lattices. The abstract AM-space statement is close in mechanism to the recent C(K) construction, so an equivalent formulation under different terminology remains a residual literature risk despite targeted searches.
title: Disjoint sequences are metric-functionally null in every AM-space
